title: econ unit test silently passes when catalogs fail to load
detail: A plain return leaves the test green on load failure — the W3 pin vanishes exactly when the fixture is broken. The repo's own sibling uses testing.fail_now for this path.
recommended_fix: Replace print-and-return with testing.fail_now(t, "econ unit cannot load the catalogs") as a11y_oracle_test.odin:19 does, so a broken data/ fixture fails the suite.

title: dot_interval_ticks exact-ceiling accept (20000) unpinned; > vs >= regression ships green
detail: Reject side pins 20001/25000; no test loads 20000 (grep: absent repo-wide). Flipping > to >= rejects the legitimate ceiling value while every row stays green (BAL_VALID uses 2400).
recommended_fix: Add a positive boundary row: a balance doc with dot_interval_ticks=20000 must load clean (the valid-docs pattern, cerr.file == ""), pinning the accept edge of the ceiling.

title: Tautological sanity assertion: stats.crises >= 0 can never fail
detail: crises is a non-negative i32 counter; no mutation of the code under test can fail this line — a vacuous pin in a test whose stated purpose is anti-vacuity.
recommended_fix: Delete the line, or pin a real invariant of the deterministic bot, e.g. stats.other_errs == 0 (the uncounted-draw-error counter must stay clean on the real catalog).

title: Trigger-tick crisis latch has no direct pin; regression only conditionally observable
detail: The latch's only guard is the scenario gate; reverting it stays green whenever any crisis dot lands on a non-trigger tick — the W6 fix itself is unpinned at unit level.
recommended_fix: Extend econ_test.odin with an era-3 surge-window run asserting dots_during_crisis > 0 (the gate's premise at unit level); full trigger-tick semantics stay sim-owned.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: 8 behavior changes traced: 6 FULL, 2 PARTIAL, 0 NONE. P0 (econ gate automation + Q7 clock/no-death-spiral bounds: CI step, verb dispatch, all 7 scenario FAIL asserts) 100%; P1 100%; overall ~85%. Residuals are P2/P3: ceiling accept-edge, latch pin, load-guard consistency.
